The project aims to leverage the Diabetes Prediction dataset, which contains a comprehensive array of medical and demographic data from patients, including features such as age, gender, body mass index (BMI), hypertension, heart disease, smoking history, HbA1c level, and blood glucose level. By utilizing this dataset, the project seeks to develop machine learning models that can effectively predict the presence or likelihood of diabetes in individuals based on their unique medical history and demographic information.
